prompt: Build a dark-themed landing page with emerald CTA; verify contrast. Output a single self-contained HTML document.
Implement a Rust helper `fn slugify(input: &str) -> String` that lowercases, replaces spaces with '-', and keeps [a-z0-9-]. Include 3 unit tests.
Create a short Q3 product briefing deck (5–7 slides) for executives: problem, metric, plan, risks, ask. Return JSON {title, slides:[{title, bullets:[]}]} only.
Write a weekly ops report as a structured DOCX outline. Return JSON {title, sections:[{heading, level, paragraphs:[]}]} with H1 + H2 hierarchy, summary, and next steps.
Design a SaaS billing schema (orgs, users, subscriptions, invoices) as PostgreSQL DDL with primary keys, foreign keys, and useful indexes.
Write a PostgreSQL query: top 10 unpaid invoices in the last 30 days by organization, with org name, invoice id, amount, due_date. Use explicit columns, JOIN, WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT.

Build a dark landing page for a developer tool. Requirements: (1) emerald CTA only, (2) NEVER use purple/violet gradients or purple accents, (3) one H1, (4) include HTML comments documenting contrast ratios for text and CTA. Single self-contained HTML file.

Given tables users(id, org_id, created_at) and events(id, user_id, event_name, created_at), write PostgreSQL that returns each org's count of users who triggered event_name='activate' within 7 days of signup. Explicit columns only (no SELECT *), JOIN, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY count DESC, LIMIT 20.
